title: Double Wires

title: Elastic Man

title: Flappy 2048

title: Flash Tetris

title: FNF Pokepasta Perdition
description: A Friday Night Funkin' crossover featuring creepypasta Pokemon characters. Rap battle against haunted and corrupted Pokemon in this unique rhythm game mashup. Features custom songs, spooky visuals, and the unsettling atmosphere of Pokemon creepypasta legends.

title: Geometry Dash
description: The famous rhythm-platformer. Jump to the beat and survive the obstacle course.

title: Geometry Dash Online
description: Rhythm-based platformer. Jump and fly through dangerous passages synced to music. Precise timing required. The original online version.

title: Hacker Typer

Ken Griffey Jr. Presents Major League Baseball

description: Sequel to the stunt car hit, with more cars and bigger maps.

title: Minesweeper
description: The classic grid of numbers and mines. Click carefully.

title: Mini Putt

title: Moto X3M

title: Moto X3M: Pool Party

title: Moto X3M: Spooky
description: Halloween-themed Moto X3M with spooky hazards.

New Super Mario World 2: Around the World
Ninja

title: Papas Pizzeria
description: Make pizzas for picky customers in this iconic time-management series entry.

title: Paper.io 2
description: Expand your territory by drawing paper-like lines. Do not let anyone cross yours.

title: Papery Planes
description: Fly paper airplanes through sketched obstacle courses.

title: Particle Clicker
description: Idle-clicker physics simulator. Collect particles, fund research, advance science.

title: Pokemon Academy Life Forever
description: A visual novel-style Pokemon game set in a Pokemon trainer academy. Build relationships with classmates, attend Pokemon battling classes, and navigate school life. Features dating sim elements, character-driven storytelling, and a unique slice-of-life Pokemon experience.

title: Pokemon All In
description: A comprehensive ROM hack that goes all in on content. Features Pokemon from all generations, multiple difficulty options, expanded areas, quality-of-life improvements, and a wealth of content. Designed for players who want everything Pokemon has to offer in one game.

title: Pokemon Ambrosia
description: A mythologically inspired ROM hack set in a region based on ancient legends. Features an original story involving divine Pokemon and mortal conflicts, custom maps, Pokemon from multiple generations, and a narrative steeped in mythology and wonder.

title: Pokemon Battle Factory
description: A ROM hack centered around the Battle Factory challenge. Rent random Pokemon and battle through increasingly difficult trainers, swapping team members as you go. Tests your adaptability and knowledge of Pokemon without relying on your own trained team.

title: Pokemon Black
description: Set in the New York-inspired Unova region with 156 entirely new Pokemon. Features a compelling story about the morality of capturing Pokemon, animated battle sprites, seasonal changes, Triple and Rotation Battles, and the enigmatic N. Only new Pokemon are available until post-game.

title: Pokemon Black 2
description: A direct sequel set two years after Black/White â€” a first for the series. Features a new protagonist, new areas in Unova, the Pokemon World Tournament where you battle every past Champion, the Challenge Mode difficulty, and a mix of old and new Pokemon from the start.

title: Pokemon Black 2 (Alt)
description: An alternate version of the direct sequel to Pokemon Black. Set two years later in a changed Unova with new cities, the Pokemon World Tournament featuring past Champions, Memory Link to connect with your Black/White save, and an expanded Unova Pokedex.

title: Pokemon Black (Alt)
description: An alternate version of Pokemon Black for Nintendo DS. Experience the Unova region with its compelling narrative about truth and ideals, 156 new Pokemon, animated sprites, and the unique challenge of only encountering new Pokemon until beating the main story.

title: Pokemon Blaze Black 2 Redux
description: A comprehensive difficulty hack of Pokemon Black 2 by Drayano. All 649 Pokemon obtainable, trainers have improved teams, Gym Leaders use competitive strategies, and difficulty is significantly increased. Features updated movesets and the definitive challenging Black 2 experience.

title: Pokemon Blue
description: The companion game to Pokemon Red set in the Kanto region. Features the same core adventure with different wild Pokemon availability. Catch, train, and battle 151 Pokemon as you travel across Kanto, defeat Team Rocket, and challenge the Pokemon League.

title: Pokemon Classic
description: A nostalgia-focused hack that recreates the classic Pokemon experience with subtle improvements. Maintains the original feel of early Pokemon games while fixing bugs, improving balance, and adding small quality-of-life features. Pure classic Pokemon gaming.

title: Pokemon Crown
description: A royal-themed Pokemon hack featuring a new region with a monarchy-based storyline. Features custom events, characters with complex motivations, Pokemon from multiple generations, and a narrative that explores themes of power and responsibility in the Pokemon world.

title: Pokemon Crystal Advance Redux
description: A GBA reimagining of Pokemon Crystal with enhanced graphics, modern mechanics, updated Pokemon stats and movesets, quality-of-life improvements, and the Fairy type. The Johto adventure rebuilt on the GBA engine with a polished and refined gameplay experience.

title: Pokemon Crystal Clear
description: A groundbreaking open-world hack of Pokemon Crystal. Start in any town, choose from 24 starters, tackle Gyms in any order, and customize your character. Gyms scale to your badge count. Features both Johto and Kanto with complete freedom of exploration â€” a true open-world Pokemon game.

title: Pokemon Dark Rising
description: A challenging FireRed-based hack set in the Core region where you must rescue your father and save the world from Darugis. Features a gripping story, Pokemon from multiple generations, tough trainers, unique abilities, and increased difficulty. One of the classic ROM hacks beloved by the community.

title: Pokemon Diamond
description: Explore the Sinnoh region in this Generation IV NDS title. Features 107 new Pokemon, the physical/special split that revolutionized competitive play, Wi-Fi trading and battling, the Underground for mining, and the legendary Dialga that controls time. A beloved entry in the series.

title: Pokemon Dream Stone
description: A mystical ROM hack revolving around a powerful Dream Stone artifact. Features an original story with dream-world exploration, custom events, Pokemon from multiple generations, and a narrative that blurs the line between dreams and reality in the Pokemon world.

title: Pokemon Elite Redux
description: A difficulty-focused hack that overhauls the Elite Four and champion battles with competitively viable teams. Gym Leaders are also significantly tougher. Features rebalanced Pokemon, updated movesets, and a challenging experience designed for experienced players.

title: Pokemon Elysium A
description: Version A of Pokemon Elysium, set in a paradise-like region with its own mythology. Features an original story about an idyllic Pokemon world with hidden darkness, custom maps, Pokemon from multiple generations, and unique plot elements that reveal the truth behind Elysium.

title: Pokemon Elysium B
description: Version B of Pokemon Elysium, the companion game with different encounters and version-exclusive content. Explore the same paradise region from a different perspective with unique Pokemon availability and story elements that complement Version A.

title: Pokemon Emerald Enhanced
description: Pokemon Emerald with careful enhancements that respect the original experience. Features quality-of-life fixes, all Pokemon obtainable without trading, rebalanced encounters, improved move tutors, and subtle difficulty adjustments. Perfect for fans who want a polished Emerald experience.

title: Pokemon Emerald Exceeded
description: An ambitious Emerald hack pushing the GBA to its limits. Features Pokemon up to Gen 8, Mega Evolution, Z-Moves, Dynamax, a complete Fairy type implementation, updated abilities, modern battle mechanics, and a significantly expanded roster. One of the most content-rich GBA hacks.

title: Pokemon Emerald Horizons
description: A fresh take on Emerald featuring new storylines, characters, and areas alongside the familiar Hoenn region. Includes modern Pokemon, quality-of-life features, custom events, and an engaging narrative that expands upon the original Emerald story.

title: Pokemon Emerald Imperium (GBA)
description: A GBA-based Emerald enhancement featuring expanded Pokemon rosters from multiple generations, rebalanced difficulty, improved movesets, Mega Evolutions, and quality-of-life improvements. Explore a revitalized Hoenn with modern competitive mechanics.

title: Pokemon Emerald Randomized
description: Pokemon Emerald with fully randomized wild encounters, trainer teams, items, and abilities. Every playthrough is unique â€” your starter, wild Pokemon, and opponent teams are all shuffled. A chaotic and replayable way to experience Hoenn where anything can happen.

title: Pokemon Emerald Rogue
description: A groundbreaking roguelike hack of Pokemon Emerald. Each run generates random routes, encounters, and challenges. Collect items, build a team, and try to beat all 8 Gyms in a single run. Death means starting over. Features Pokemon from all generations and unlockable perks between runs.

title: Pokemon Emerald Rogue EX
description: The expanded edition of Emerald Rogue with even more Pokemon, items, challenges, and unlockables. This roguelike experience generates a new adventure each run with random routes, trainers, and wild encounters. Features enhanced difficulty modes and more strategic depth.

title: Pokemon Emerald Z
description: A comprehensive Emerald overhaul featuring Z-Moves from Sun and Moon, Mega Evolutions, Pokemon from later generations, updated type chart with Fairy type, and rebalanced difficulty. Experience Hoenn with the power of Z-Crystals and modern battle mechanics.

title: Pokemon Fire Gold
description: A hack that combines FireRed's engine with Gold's Johto adventure. Explore Johto with GBA-quality graphics, modern mechanics, and enhanced visuals. Features the full Johto storyline rebuilt on the FireRed engine with improvements and expanded content.

title: Pokemon Flora
description: A nature-themed ROM hack set in a lush region filled with unique environments. Features an original story centered around the balance of nature, custom maps and events, Pokemon from multiple generations, and a serene atmosphere with challenging battles.

title: Pokemon FRLG Plus
description: An enhanced version of FireRed/LeafGreen adding quality-of-life improvements, expanded Pokemon availability, updated movesets, the Fairy type, and rebalanced difficulty. All the nostalgia of Kanto with the polish of modern Pokemon game design.

title: Pokemon Fused Dimension
description: Explore a dimension where all Pokemon are fusions of two different species. Every encounter is a unique combination with merged designs, types, and abilities. Features over 400 fusion Pokemon, an original story about the dimension rift, and creative creature designs throughout.

title: Pokemon Fusion 3
description: The third installment in the Pokemon Fusion series with even more fusion combinations. Fuse any two Pokemon together to create unique hybrids. Features improved fusion sprites, a new region, updated mechanics, and thousands of possible fusion combinations to discover.

title: Pokemon Gaia
description: A critically acclaimed ROM hack set in the Orbtus region with an original story about ancient earthquakes threatening the land. Features Pokemon up to Gen 6, Mega Evolution, updated mechanics, Rock Climb HM, underground mining, and some of the best custom mapping in any hack.

title: Pokemon Golden Shield
description: A ROM hack featuring a knight-themed region with a storyline about defending the land. Features custom characters, medieval-inspired settings, Pokemon from multiple generations, and a narrative centered around heroism and protection of the Pokemon world.

title: Pokemon GS Chronicles
description: A modern GBA reimagining of Pokemon Gold and Silver with stunning updated graphics, new sprites, Pokemon from multiple generations, Mega Evolution, the Fairy type, and expanded content. Experience the beloved Johto journey like never before with beautiful custom artwork.

title: Pokemon HeartGold
description: The beloved DS remake of Pokemon Gold with stunning updated graphics, your lead Pokemon walking behind you, the Pokeathlon mini-games, and the PokeWalker accessory support. Explore both Johto and Kanto with 16 Gym Badges and challenge Red atop Mt. Silver once more.

title: Pokemon HeartGold Generations
description: A HeartGold hack that adds Pokemon from all generations into the Johto and Kanto adventure. Catch Gen 1-8 Pokemon, enjoy updated movesets and abilities, and experience the beloved HGSS adventure with a massively expanded Pokedex and modern Pokemon.

title: Pokemon Light Platinum
description: One of the most popular ROM hacks ever made. Features two full regions (Zhery and Lauren), Pokemon from Gens 1-5, the World Championship, legendaries from all generations, Mega Evolution, and an original story. A massive adventure rivaling official Pokemon games in scope.

title: Pokemon Liquid Crystal
description: A stunning GBA remake of Pokemon Crystal with redesigned maps, updated graphics, Pokemon from later generations, the Orange Islands from the anime, new events, and expanded content. Relive the Johto adventure in a beautiful new way with a massive post-game.

title: Pokemon Mega Moemon
description: A ROM hack where all Pokemon are replaced with anime-style girl sprites (Moemon) featuring Mega Evolutions. The same core gameplay with a unique aesthetic twist. All Pokemon are reimagined as cute character designs with their own Mega Evolution forms.

title: Pokemon Mega Power
description: An Emerald-based hack where you play as a scientist seeking to create the most powerful Pokemon. Features Mega Evolutions, Pokemon from multiple generations, custom maps, a unique story about scientific ambition and ethics, and updated battle mechanics. Part of the beloved Pokemon Ruby Destiny series.

title: Pokemon Amnesia
description: A story-driven ROM hack where you wake up with no memories in a mysterious region. Piece together your past through exploration and battles. Features an original narrative, custom events, Pokemon from multiple generations, and plot twists that keep you guessing until the end.

title: Pokemon Clover
description: A comedic FireRed hack featuring 386 entirely original fan-made Pokemon (Fakemon). Born from online community creativity with humorous designs, custom music, a full new region, and surprisingly deep gameplay. Features Fairy type and a unique, satirical tone throughout.

title: Pokemon Crystal
description: The enhanced version of Gold and Silver, and the first Pokemon game to let you play as a female trainer. Features animated Pokemon sprites, the Battle Tower, an expanded Suicune storyline, and the Odd Egg event. Widely considered the definitive Gen II experience.

title: Pokemon Emerald
description: The definitive Hoenn experience combining Ruby and Sapphire's stories. Features the legendary Rayquaza, the Battle Frontier with seven challenging facilities, Pokemon Animations in battle, and an expanded post-game. Both Team Magma and Team Aqua appear as antagonists in this enhanced version.

title: Pokemon Emerald Crest
description: A massive quality-of-life Emerald hack featuring Mega Evolution, Pokemon up to Gen 9, a built-in randomizer, following Pokemon, day/night cycle, DexNav, auto-run, Fairy type, and the ability to catch all 898+ Pokemon. One of the most feature-rich Emerald hacks available.

title: Pokemon Emerald Imperium
description: A feature-packed Emerald hack with Pokemon from Gens 1-8, Mega Evolutions, updated move pools, a revamped difficulty curve, new events, and quality-of-life improvements. Experience Hoenn with modern Pokemon mechanics and a greatly expanded roster of catchable Pokemon.

title: Pokemon Emerald Kaizo
description: An extremely challenging difficulty hack of Pokemon Emerald designed for expert players. Every trainer has competitively optimized teams with perfect IVs and strategic movesets. Gym Leaders and the Elite Four are brutally difficult. Not for the faint of heart â€” this is Pokemon at its hardest.

title: Pokemon Emerald Mini
description: A condensed version of Pokemon Emerald designed for quicker playthroughs. The core Hoenn experience is streamlined with reduced grinding, faster level progression, and trimmed filler content while preserving the essential story beats and key battles.

title: Pokemon Emerald Rogue (Alt)
description: An alternate build of the popular Emerald Rogue roguelike hack. Procedurally generated routes and encounters make every run unique. Build your team strategically, defeat Gym Leaders, and try to complete the Pokemon League before your run ends.

title: Pokemon Emerald Seaglass
description: A comprehensive Emerald ROM hack that adds Pokemon from later generations, quality-of-life improvements, new areas to explore, rebalanced difficulty, and modern battle mechanics. Explore a refreshed Hoenn region with updated encounters and an expanded post-game.

title: Pokemon Energized Emerald
description: An enhanced Emerald hack that injects modern features into the classic Hoenn adventure. Features Pokemon from multiple generations, updated movesets, rebalanced stats, quality-of-life changes like reusable TMs, and a more challenging difficulty curve throughout the game.

title: Pokemon Evolved
description: An Emerald hack that evolves the classic formula with new Pokemon forms, updated movesets, rebalanced stats, and quality-of-life improvements. Features modern mechanics grafted onto the GBA engine and a refreshed take on the Hoenn adventure.

title: Pokemon FireRed
description: A faithful GBA remake of the original Pokemon Red with updated graphics, the Sevii Islands post-game, a helpful tutorial system, and compatibility with Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald for trading. Relive the classic Kanto journey with Generation III mechanics and quality-of-life improvements.

title: Pokemon FireRed & LeafGreen Plus
description: An enhanced version of FireRed/LeafGreen with Pokemon from multiple generations, improved graphics, quality-of-life features, updated movesets, and the Fairy type. The classic Kanto adventure with modern conveniences and an expanded Pokedex for catching them all.

title: Pokemon FireRed Randomized
description: Pokemon FireRed with all wild encounters, trainer teams, and items completely randomized. Your starter, every wild Pokemon, and all opponent teams are shuffled for maximum unpredictability. Relive Kanto in a completely new way where anything from Magikarp to Mewtwo could appear anywhere.

title: Pokemon Gold
description: Travel through the Johto region in this Generation II classic. Features 100 new Pokemon, a real-time day/night cycle, Pokemon breeding, held items, and two new types (Dark and Steel). After the Johto League, return to Kanto for a second adventure culminating in a battle against Red atop Mt. Silver.

title: Pokemon Kaizo Iron FireRed
description: An extremely difficult FireRed hack combining Kaizo-level challenge with iron rules. Trainers have perfectly optimized teams, wild encounters are limited, and every battle requires strategic thinking. Designed for hardcore Pokemon veterans seeking the ultimate challenge.

title: Pokemon Lazarus
description: A unique ROM hack set in a post-apocalyptic Pokemon world. Civilization has collapsed, and wild Pokemon roam freely in the ruins. Features a dark and mature storyline, survival elements, custom events, and a refreshing take on the Pokemon formula in a bleak setting.

title: Pokemon LeafGreen
description: The GBA remake of Pokemon Blue/Green with modernized graphics and gameplay. Features the same Kanto adventure with Sevii Islands, updated mechanics from Generation III, a wireless adapter for trading, and the ability to catch Johto and Hoenn Pokemon in the post-game.

title: Pokemon Modern Emerald
description: Emerald brought into the modern era with Gen 8+ Pokemon, updated mechanics, quality-of-life features like auto-EXP share, reusable TMs, Fairy type, modern abilities, and a rebalanced difficulty. The classic Hoenn journey with contemporary Pokemon gameplay standards.

title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team
description: You wake up as a Pokemon with no memory of being human! Form a rescue team and explore randomly generated dungeons in this roguelike spinoff. Recruit over 400 Pokemon to your team, take on rescue missions, and uncover the mystery of your transformation and the natural disasters plaguing the world.

title: Pokemon Perfect Emerald 5.5
description: A meticulously polished Emerald hack focused on perfecting the gameplay experience. Version 5.5 includes all Pokemon obtainable, competitive-ready features, rebalanced encounters, QoL improvements, and careful difficulty tuning. Designed for players who want Emerald at its absolute best.

title: Pokemon Platinum
description: The definitive Sinnoh experience with Giratina and the Distortion World. Features the Battle Frontier, Wi-Fi Plaza, expanded Pokedex, new forms for Giratina/Shaymin/Rotom, improved speed and animations, and a richer story involving both Dialga and Palkia. The best way to experience Gen IV.

title: Pokemon Quetzal
description: A multiplayer-capable Emerald hack that allows up to 4 players to play together. Features Pokemon from all generations, Mega Evolution, Fusion mechanics, following Pokemon, character customization, and both cooperative and competitive multiplayer modes. A social Pokemon experience.

title: Pokemon Roaring Red
description: A FireRed hack that cranks up the intensity with a tougher difficulty, expanded Pokemon roster, new events, and enhanced trainer battles. Experience a more challenging and content-rich Kanto adventure with updated mechanics and surprises around every corner.

title: Pokemon Rocket Edition (Alt)
description: An alternate version of the Team Rocket role-reversal hack. Join Team Rocket, steal from trainers, and work your way up through the criminal organization. Features the Kanto story retold from the villain's perspective with unique missions and moral dilemmas.

title: Pokemon Ruby
description: Explore the tropical Hoenn region in this Generation III adventure. Features 135 new Pokemon, Double Battles, Abilities, Natures, Pokemon Contests, and Secret Bases. Lead Team Magma's quest to expand the land with the legendary Groudon. A massive leap in graphics and gameplay depth.

title: Pokemon Saiph
description: An original ROM hack set in the Colen region with a space-themed storyline involving alien threats and interdimensional travel. Features Pokemon from Gens 1-7, custom music, new characters, Mega Evolution, and a gripping sci-fi narrative that stands out from typical Pokemon games.

title: Pokemon Saiph 2
description: The sequel to Pokemon Saiph continuing the space saga in a new region. Features improved graphics, an expanded story with more sci-fi elements, Pokemon from multiple generations, custom music, and deeper gameplay mechanics. The continuation of one of the most unique Pokemon hack storylines.

title: Pokemon Sapphire
description: The companion to Pokemon Ruby set in Hoenn. Features Team Aqua as the villainous team seeking to expand the sea using the legendary Kyogre. Enjoy the same rich gameplay with different Pokemon encounters, Double Battles, Contests, and the vast underwater diving routes.

title: Pokemon Shin Sigma
description: A comprehensive ROM hack combining content from multiple Pokemon games. Features an expanded roster, enhanced difficulty, rebalanced mechanics, custom events, and a massive amount of content. Designed to be the ultimate combined Pokemon experience.

title: Pokemon Silver
description: The companion to Pokemon Gold set in the Johto region. Features the legendary Pokemon Lugia on the cover and different wild Pokemon encounters. Enjoy the day/night system, breed Pokemon, and explore both Johto and Kanto in this massive adventure with 16 Gym Badges to collect.

title: Pokemon SL Green
description: A quality-of-life enhanced version of Pokemon LeafGreen with updated Pokemon availability, modern mechanics, improved movesets, Fairy type, and subtle difficulty adjustments. The familiar Kanto adventure polished to modern standards.

title: Pokemon SM Red
description: A FireRed hack infused with Sun and Moon content. Features Alolan forms, Z-Moves, Pokemon from Gen 7, updated mechanics, and the tropical flavor of Alola blended into the classic Kanto adventure. Experience Red with a Sun/Moon twist.

title: Pokemon Snap
description: A unique N64 photography game where you ride through on-rails environments taking pictures of Pokemon in their natural habitats. Professor Oak scores your photos based on size, pose, and technique. Use items like apples and Pester Balls to get Pokemon to pose and reveal hidden behaviors.

title: Pokemon SORS
description: A Spanish-developed ROM hack with a compelling original story set in a new region. Features custom sprites, maps, and music, Pokemon from multiple generations, innovative plot elements involving legendary Pokemon lore, and high production values throughout.

title: Pokemon SORS 2
description: The sequel to Pokemon SORS continuing the original storyline with new regions, characters, and challenges. Features enhanced visuals, more Pokemon, deeper narrative elements, and the continuation of the mysteries established in the first game.

title: Pokemon Stadium
description: The N64 battle arena featuring full 3D Pokemon battles. Challenge the Stadium Cups, Gym Leader Castle, and the Elite Four with rental Pokemon or transfer your own from the Game Boy games. Features fun mini-games and the ability to play your GB Pokemon games on the TV.

title: Pokemon Tower Defense
description: A fan-made tower defense game using Pokemon mechanics. Strategically place your Pokemon along paths to defend against waves of wild Pokemon. Catch, train, and evolve Pokemon to build the ultimate defensive team. Features Gym battles, shiny hunting, and multiplayer trading.

title: Pokemon Ultimate Fusion
description: A hack where Pokemon can be fused together to create entirely new combinations. Mix and match different species to create unique hybrids with combined types, abilities, and appearances. Features a massive number of possible fusions for endless experimentation.

title: Pokemon Unbound
description: Widely considered the best Pokemon ROM hack ever made. Set in the Borrius region with a brand-new story, 900+ Pokemon from all generations, Mega Evolution, Z-Moves, Dynamax, a mission system, character customization, difficulty modes, and a massive post-game. Incredible production quality.

title: Pokemon Volume 1
description: The first volume in a Pokemon game compilation series. Features a curated selection of Pokemon challenges, battles, and scenarios. Enjoy classic Pokemon gameplay with unique twists and a structured progression through themed content.

title: Pokemon Volume 2
description: The second volume continuing the Pokemon compilation series with new challenges and content. Features different Pokemon, new battle scenarios, and fresh gameplay twists. Each volume offers a distinct set of experiences for Pokemon fans.

title: Pokemon Volume 3
description: The third installment of the Pokemon Volume series with even more content. New challenges, Pokemon encounters, and battle formats await. Features unique scenarios and gameplay modes not found in the previous volumes.

title: Pokemon Volume 4
description: The fourth and latest entry in the Pokemon Volume compilation. Brings together the best elements of previous volumes with new additions. Features fresh challenges, rare Pokemon encounters, and evolved gameplay mechanics.

title: Pokemon Moon Emerald
description: An Emerald hack that brings Alolan Pokemon and themes into Hoenn. Features Alolan forms, Pokemon from Sun and Moon, updated moves and abilities, and a tropical twist on the classic Hoenn adventure. Catch Alolan variants alongside Hoenn natives.

title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Sky
description: The definitive version of the Explorers series with one of the most emotional stories in any Pokemon game. Join an exploration guild, travel through time, and save the world from a dark future. Features new starter Pokemon, Special Episodes that expand the story, and the beloved Grovyle storyline.

title: Pokemon Nameless
description: A FireRed hack with an original story where you play as a trainer in a custom region. Features Pokemon from multiple generations, custom events and characters, a compelling narrative with plot twists, and polished gameplay that keeps you engaged throughout the journey.

title: Pokemon Odyssey
description: An ambitious ROM hack taking you on an epic journey through a vast new region. Features an original storyline, custom maps, Pokemon from multiple generations, innovative gameplay mechanics, and a grand adventure worthy of the Odyssey name.

title: Pokemon Pasta
description: A creepypasta-inspired Pokemon hack with horror elements woven into the familiar Pokemon formula. Features unsettling events, dark storylines, and eerie twists on classic Pokemon gameplay. Not your typical Pokemon adventure â€” expect the unexpected and the disturbing.

title: Pokemon Path
description: A ROM hack focused on the journey of becoming a Pokemon master through a custom region. Features branching paths, meaningful choices that affect the story, Pokemon from multiple generations, and a narrative that emphasizes the personal growth of your trainer.

title: Pokemon Pearl
description: The companion to Diamond set in Sinnoh, featuring the legendary Palkia that controls space. Enjoy the physical/special attack split, Super Contests, the Sinnoh Underground, and Wi-Fi features. Different wild Pokemon encounters complement Diamond for completing the Pokedex.

title: Pokemon Perfect FireRed
description: A refined FireRed hack that perfects the Kanto experience. All Pokemon are obtainable, difficulty is carefully rebalanced, moves and abilities are updated to modern standards, and quality-of-life improvements make the game smoother without losing its classic charm.

title: Pokemon Pisces
description: A water-themed Pokemon hack featuring aquatic environments, ocean exploration, and a storyline centered around the seas. Includes Pokemon from multiple generations with an emphasis on Water-types, custom maps, diving mechanics, and a unique nautical adventure.

title: Pokemon Platinum (Alt)
description: An alternate version of Pokemon Platinum for the Nintendo DS. Journey through Sinnoh, encounter the legendary Giratina in the Distortion World, challenge the Battle Frontier, and become the Pokemon Champion. Features the physical/special split and Wi-Fi connectivity.

title: Pokemon Platinum Randomized
description: Pokemon Platinum with fully randomized wild encounters, trainer teams, and items. Your starter and every Pokemon you encounter are completely random, creating a unique and unpredictable Sinnoh adventure every time you play.

title: Pokemon Polished Crystal
description: An ambitious overhaul of Pokemon Crystal featuring all 251 original Pokemon plus new additions, updated graphics, quality-of-life improvements, the physical/special split, new areas, expanded post-game content, and modernized mechanics. One of the most polished GBC ROM hacks ever made.

title: Pokemon Pure Blue
description: A refined version of the original Pokemon Blue focusing on a pure, clean experience. Features quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, balanced encounters, and a faithful-yet-improved recreation of the classic Kanto journey without straying from the original vision.

title: Pokemon Pure Green
description: An enhanced version of Pokemon Green (the original Japanese release) translated and improved for English audiences. Features updated sprites, quality-of-life improvements, and the unique Pokemon Green experience that was never officially released outside Japan.

title: Pokemon Pure Red
description: A polished version of Pokemon Red with quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, and balanced gameplay. Stays faithful to the original Kanto adventure while smoothing out rough edges for a clean, enjoyable retro experience.

title: Pokemon Radical Red
description: A challenging FireRed-based hack with competitive difficulty, modern battle mechanics, and all Pokemon through Gen 8. Features updated AI, tough gym leaders, and a complete Pokedex overhaul. Perfect for players seeking a hardcore experience.

title: Pokemon Recharged Pink
description: A vibrant ROM hack with a pink-themed aesthetic and recharged gameplay. Features updated Pokemon encounters, rebalanced difficulty, modern mechanics, quality-of-life improvements, and a fresh visual style that gives the classic adventure a colorful makeover.

title: Pokemon Recharged Yellow
description: Pokemon Yellow reimagined with modern features and recharged gameplay. Pikachu still follows you, but now with updated mechanics, expanded Pokemon availability, quality-of-life improvements, and a refreshed difficulty curve. The Pikachu Edition revitalized.

title: Pokemon Record Keepers
description: A ROM hack focused on tracking and completing records and achievements. Features a challenge-based progression system, comprehensive Pokedex tracking, battle records, and reward systems for completionists who want to catch, battle, and record everything.

title: Pokemon Red
description: The original Pokemon RPG that started it all. Journey through the Kanto region as a young trainer, catch and train 151 Pokemon, battle eight Gym Leaders, and take on the Elite Four to become the Pokemon Champion. Choose between Bulbasaur, Charmander, or Squirtle as your starter.

title: Pokemon Renegade Platinum
description: The definitive Platinum difficulty hack by Drayano. Every trainer has improved teams, all 493 Pokemon are obtainable, Pokemon have updated movesets and abilities, Gym Leaders use full teams of 6 with held items. Widely considered the gold standard of Pokemon difficulty hacks.

title: Pokemon Rocket Edition
description: Play as a Team Rocket grunt in this unique role-reversal hack. Steal Pokemon, carry out missions for Giovanni, and rise through the Rocket ranks. Experience the Kanto story from the villain's perspective with moral choices, a gripping narrative, and a fresh take on the Pokemon world.

title: Pokemon ROWE
description: An open-world Emerald hack where you can explore Hoenn in any order. All 8 Gyms scale to your level, Pokemon from all generations are available, and you choose your own path. Features following Pokemon, Mega Evolution, quality-of-life fixes, and true freedom of exploration.

title: Pokemon Ruby (GBA)
description: The original Pokemon Ruby for Game Boy Advance. Journey through Hoenn, battle Team Magma, catch Groudon, and challenge the Pokemon League. Features 135 new Pokemon, Double Battles, Abilities, Natures, Contests, and Secret Bases in the tropical Hoenn region.

title: Pokemon Run and Bun
description: A fast-paced roguelike Pokemon hack where speed and efficiency matter. Make quick decisions, build a team on the fly, and race through challenges. Features randomized elements, time pressure mechanics, and a unique blend of Pokemon battling and speedrun-style gameplay.

title: Pokemon Scorched Silver
description: A difficulty and content hack of Pokemon Silver with rebalanced teams, updated movesets, expanded Pokemon availability, and tougher Gym Leaders. Experience the Johto adventure with a fiercer challenge and modern quality-of-life improvements.

title: Pokemon SoulSilver
description: The DS remake of Pokemon Silver featuring the legendary Lugia. Your Pokemon follows you in the overworld, enjoy the Pokeathlon, Safari Zone customization, and the massive dual-region adventure. Widely regarded as one of the best Pokemon games ever made with incredible post-game content.

title: Pokemon The Pit
description: A survival-style Pokemon hack where you're trapped in a dungeon-like pit and must battle your way out. Features increasingly difficult floors, limited resources, strategic team building, and a claustrophobic atmosphere. How deep can you go â€” or can you escape?

title: Pokemon Theta Emerald EX
description: One of the most comprehensive Emerald hacks featuring 721 Pokemon from Gens 1-6, Mega Evolutions, Primal Reversion, updated moves and abilities, Fairy type, reusable TMs, and the Exp. Share as an on/off toggle. A must-play for fans wanting the complete Pokemon experience on GBA.

title: Pokemon Too Many Types 2
description: A chaotic hack that adds dozens of new types beyond the standard 18. Every Pokemon has wild new type combinations, creating absurd and hilarious interactions. Features a completely rebalanced type chart with types like Sound, Cosmic, Digital, and more. Pure creative madness.

title: Pokemon Tourmaline
description: A gem-themed ROM hack set in a custom region inspired by crystalline landscapes. Features an original story involving powerful gem-based artifacts, Pokemon from multiple generations, custom maps with unique environments, and a polished adventure from start to finish.

title: Pokemon Ultra Shiny Gold Sigma
description: The ultimate Shiny Gold Sigma experience, a FireRed-based remake of Pokemon Gold. Features all 386 Gen I-III Pokemon, updated graphics, the physical/special split, the Orange Islands, post-game content, and a faithful Johto adventure with modern mechanics. One of the best Johto remakes on GBA.

title: Pokemon Ultra Violet
description: A FireRed hack that makes all 386 Gen I-III Pokemon catchable in a single playthrough. Features updated maps, new areas to explore, trade evolutions available without trading, additional events, and quality-of-life improvements. The complete Kanto Pokedex experience.

title: Pokemon Unova Emerald
description: Play through Hoenn with Unova's Pokemon roster replacing the native encounters. All 156 Gen V Pokemon are available in the wild, creating a unique fusion of Hoenn's world design with Unova's creature roster. A fresh way to experience both regions' Pokemon.

title: Pokemon Vega
description: A legendary Japanese ROM hack featuring 181 original Fakemon alongside classic Pokemon. Set in the Tohoak region with a completely new story, custom music, challenging difficulty, and inventive new Pokemon designs. One of the most ambitious and well-crafted Fakemon hacks.

title: Pokemon Volt White 2 Redux
description: The White 2 companion to Blaze Black 2 Redux. All 649 Pokemon obtainable with increased difficulty, improved trainer AI, competitive movesets on bosses, and rebalanced encounters. The ultimate challenging way to experience Pokemon White 2.

title: Pokemon Voyager
description: An adventure-focused ROM hack that takes you across vast landscapes and diverse environments. Features an original region, Pokemon from multiple generations, a compelling travel narrative, custom events, and the spirit of exploration at its core.

title: Pokemon White
description: The companion to Pokemon Black set in Unova, featuring the legendary Reshiram. The same compelling story with different Pokemon encounters, exclusive areas like White Forest, and the full cast of 156 new Pokemon. Enjoy Triple Battles, seasons, and the deepest Pokemon narrative yet.

title: Pokemon White 2
description: The sequel to Pokemon White set two years later in Unova. Features new areas, the Pokemon World Tournament, PokeStar Studios for making movies, Join Avenue for building a shopping mall, and a story that directly continues from the events of Pokemon White.

title: Pokemon White 2 (Alt)
description: An alternate version of Pokemon White 2. Experience the sequel adventure in Unova with new towns to explore, the Pokemon World Tournament, PokeStar Studios, and the continuation of N's story. Features both old and new Pokemon from the very start.

title: Pokemon Yellow
description: The special Pikachu Edition inspired by the anime. Pikachu follows you outside its Poke Ball and you can check its mood. All three original starters (Bulbasaur, Charmander, Squirtle) can be obtained in-game. Features updated sprites and the iconic Team Rocket duo Jessie and James.

title: PolyBranch
description: Low-poly branching racetrack. Pick your path at high speed.

title: Push the Square
description: Minimalist puzzle: push the square into the goal.

title: Sand Game
description: Falling-sand particle playground. Draw sand, water, fire, and watch chaos unfold.

title: Shell Shockers
description: Multiplayer egg-themed FPS. Play as an egg with a machine gun, pistol, sniper or more, across FFA, teams, and capture the spatula modes.

title: Super Mario 64
description: Super Mario 64 playable in-browser via WebAssembly.

title: Smash Karts
description: Multiplayer kart battle game. Pick up weapons, dodge missiles, and race through arenas. 3-minute matches, tons of unlockables.

title: Smoking Barrels
description: Wild-west quick-draw duel game. Who fires first?

title: Snow Battle
description: Frosty snowball fight in 2D.

title: Soldier Legend
description: Retro side-scrolling soldier shooter.

title: Stack
description: Stack falling blocks as high as you can. Simple but addictive.

title: Stack Bump 3D
description: 3D stacking puzzle with ball physics.

title: Stealing the Diamond
description: Henry Stickmin heist: steal the giant diamond. Pick options, laugh at fails.

title: Subway Surfers
description: The mobile hit. Run, dodge trains, collect coins through urban streets.

title: Super Mario World The Secret Of The 7 Golden Statues
Super Mario World The Secret Of The 7 Golden Statues
Tactical Assassin 2
description: Sniper-rifle mission game. Read the brief, line up the shot.

title: Tank Trouble 2
description: Classic 2-3 player tank maze combat.

title: The Battle
description: Medieval battle simulator with unit upgrades.

title: The Final Earth
description: Build a post-apocalyptic city on a floating chunk of rock.

title: The Heist
description: Henry Stickmin heist: break into the bank. Bad choices lead to funny deaths.

title: There Is No Game
description: Hilarious anti-game puzzle experience. You will have to see it to believe it.

title: Townscaper
description: Click to build a charming seaside town. No goals, just zen.

title: TV Static
description: Stare at the static. That is it. Cursed meme game.

title: Wolfenstein 3D
description: Play the 1992 FPS classic directly in your browser.

title: Xmen Children Of The Atom Arcade
Xmen Children Of The Atom Arcade
You Are Bezos
description: Spend Jeff Bezos's fortune on ridiculous purchases. Good luck running out.

title: Zombs Royale
description: 2D top-down battle royale. 100 players, one winner.
